classification: candidate formalization design; no source admission or world-truth proof
prohibited_shortcuts: definition of Axiom adopts the propositions of all axiom records
invariant proof target is included in its own proof premises
conviction/evidence score is substituted for logical truth

constraint.theory_entry: selected consistency context; not proof of behavior compliance

definition.theory_entry: reviewed declaration/definitional statement; test its consistency and old-vocabulary effect

derived-claim.operation: record statement, dependency context and actual evidence
derived-claim.theory_entry: only with established applicability at the required strength

hypothesis.operation: record a falsifiable proposition under investigation
hypothesis.theory_entry: not by default; a distinct selection can make it a conditional premise

observation-measurement.operation: bind observation conditions, method, uncertainty and evidence
observation-measurement.theory_entry: selected observation context; no automatic universal generalization

proof-obligation.theory_entry: query only; reject using the target or an unproved equivalent as its premise

selected-axiom.theory_entry: only after explicit selection in a named scope; claims remain conditional on it

selected-premise.theory_entry: only in its selected assumption context; never mark established truth from adoption

unresolved.operation: record ambiguity with exact source and route

source_findings.effect: That definition cannot count as fully faithful until actual precedence/correspondence review. The metamodel can represent the conflict without equating the identities.
source_findings.finding: Target clause describes investigation without adoption; inherited expression describes a premise adopted to proceed.

source_precedence.conflict_policy: Do not resolve conflicting normative/formal/source voices automatically; bind them and record an unresolved correspondence finding.
source_precedence.non_normative_voices: Do not weaken or expand normative meaning.
